0022600201.text: The Pelicans (4-5, 1-2 on the road, coming off a loss) visit the 1-7 Clippers, who have dropped seven straight and sit 13th in the West, while New Orleans is 11th in the West and 3 games back in the Southwest. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, and the Clippers will be without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Pelicans winning the last meeting 105-99 in New Orleans on March 19, 2026.
